description: Block destructive shell commands (rm -rf on dangerous targets, sudo, chmod 777, dd/mkfs on disks, fork bombs) via the tested script installed by claude-craft.
usage: Part of the default profile (install-common-rules.sh --hooks=default). The script reads the payload on stdin and exits 2 (stderr shown to Claude) to block. BLOCK_RM_RF=all blocks every recursive+forced rm; the default only blocks dangerous targets.
